reject.description: 257 bytes: a valid Authorization followed by zero bytes. Size is checked before parsing.
A valid SignedAuthorization followed by one zero byte.
gate_id contains U+03BF (Greek small omicron), a look-alike of 'o'.
path encoded as the text string "1".
expires in a 9-byte head although it fits in 5.
version = 0, every other key as auth_minimal_lmt_da.
The executor pinned the identity point as the gate key; R = identity, S = 0 satisfies the cofactorless equation, so only G0 rejects it.
Signed by agent1 (an agent key) under the Authorization tags; the executor pins gate1.
Signed by agent2's key standing in for another gate's key; the executor pins gate1.
gate1 signed edicta/v1/sig || authorization_hash (the agent signature tag).
gate1 signed edicta/v1/receipt-sig || authorization_hash (the receipt signature tag).
The Authorization bytes hashed under edicta/v1/receipt instead of edicta/v1/authorization.
Signature over the raw Authorization CBOR instead of the tagged message.
expires raised by one second after signing.
The executor pins agent1 and the signature is agent1's signature over the minimal_lmt commitment. Different tags and hashes, so it must not verify.
S + L in place of S.
The executor presents no action bytes.
The bytes the executor is about to send differ in the last byte.
The executor holds another order (qty 100001) than the one authorized.
Right bytes and salt, but the executor recomputes the hash under application/octet-stream.
mode = 1 with anchor_deadline: key 8 is not defined for mode 1.
mode = 3 with a deadline: key 8 is optional at stage D for an unknown mode, Q5 refuses.
anchor_deadline without mode: key 8 is optional while mode is unknown, then mode is missing.
